sloka: तं समीक्ष्यैव ते सर्वे दिक्षु सर्वास्ववस्थिताः ।तैस्तैः प्रहरणैर्भीमैरभिपेतुस्ततस्ततः ।। ५.४६.१९।।।।
transliteration: taṁ samīkṣyaiva te sarve dikṣu sarvāsvavasthitāḥ ।taistaiḥ praharaṇairbhīmairabhipetustatastataḥ ।। 5.46.19।।।।

translations.english: Having observed the tremendous strength, intelligence and swiftness in action of Hanuman, the generals of the army positioned at all directions and assailed him with dreadful weapons.
